pitch.subject: Quick question regarding realtor.com automation efficiency, Mickey
pitch.body:
Hi Mickey,

I noticed your leadership as CMO at realtor.com.

Most high-performing teams in Real Estate & Brokerage are currently leaking 20-30% of warm inbound inquiries due to manual lead qualification and slow response times.

We engineered an autonomous Sovereign AI Infrastructure that instantly engages, qualifies, and books inbound leads in under 15 seconds (24/7).

Would you be open to a 2-minute video walkthrough, or should I send over the technical blueprint directly?

Best regards,
John S. // Sovereign AI Systems
https://sovereign-empire-os-ub2.vercel.app
